verdict.rationale: Choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for a cloud invoicing SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions selecting a storage region, data center location, or residency controls. The security claims (PCI-DSS compliance, SSL encryption, two-factor authentication) are adjacent controls and do not address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
